name: GCD-Army Core
description: In honor of the soldiers who protect the Empire, CDS has crafted this limited-edition armor that proudly displays the seal of the UEE Army. Its shell is composed of a durable composite on the outside and a soft core on the inside, designed to absorb the types of impacts associated with on-the-ground combat. The matching helmet features a UV-blocking faceplate that protects the wearer's eye sight as they fight on the front lines under strange suns.
